designAuthority: The six approved Design Component HTML boards are the only design source of truth. Repository code is legacy wherever it contradicts this spec.

scope.approvalCondition: Phase 2 approved in source: homepage, character system pages, /design-philosophy, component docs, and Studio integration are complete; Phase 3 MCP server implementation is authorized.
scope.nextGate: Review the completed local AnUIme MCP server and schema-validated persona packs before authorizing any deployment or registry publication.
scope.nextCheckpointAfterApproval: Phase 3 review checkpoint reached. Do not deploy the MCP server or publish the registry without explicit authorization.

phase1Completion.legacyBlocksDisposition: All 10 rebuilt against registry v2 primitives; no hand-rolled skin path remains.

phase2Completion.homepage: Rebuilt around live registry v2 signature primitives and Expressive Moments.
phase2Completion.componentDocs: All registry item previews share the canonical v2 theme surface and current install path.
phase2Completion.studio: Registry v2 recipes remain URL-owned and restore component, state, viewport, zoom, and theme dimensions.

phase3Completion.transport: Official MCP SDK stateless Streamable HTTP over a Web Standards request handler, with a loopback Node adapter.
phase3Completion.reviewCoverage: Five distinct deterministic violation cases per character, plus structured clean and reduced-motion cases.

verification.localProtocol: Official client initialized anuime 2.0.0, listed 10 tools, validated the Atlas persona pack, and received two expected structured review violations.

extractionConventions.declared: Copied directly from board data or captions.
extractionConventions.normalized: Board-authored values grouped under stable machine keys without changing values.
extractionConventions.interpreted: A source conflict or scope boundary made an implementation interpretation necessary; every such field carries sourceEvidence and requires sign-off.
extractionConventions.derived: A future component treatment inferred from motif laws because no board construction exists; all such registry items are isolated in derived-not-specified.json.
